sources.title: gemma-3-4b-it: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview gemma-3-4b-it is a 4-billion-parameter instruction-tuned multimodal model from google-deepmind that processes both text and images to generate text responses. Built on the same research and technology as Google's Gemini models, it features a 128K token context window, multilingual support across 140+ languages, and is optimized for following instructions. sources.title: tunix/examples/vl_dpo_gemma3.ipynb at main · google/tunix
sources.snippet: This notebook demonstrates how to fine-tune a Vision Language Model (VLM), specifically the Gemma 3 4B IT model, using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). DPO is a method for training language models to align with human preferences without requiring a separate reward model.
